rationale: The current best family already concentrates useful capacity in the reverse recurrent tail, and recent broad curricula or head-side changes have mostly regressed. This edit keeps the quant-aware endgame intact but narrows EMA smoothing to export-sensitive tensors in and just before the recurrent tail, plus the tied output path. The hypothesis is that final int8 roundtrip quality is being limited more by late-tail/value-path jitter than by the rest of the network, so selective smoothing should help the exact quantized score without adding bytes or compile churn.
title: Selective Tail EMA Export Smoothing
